summary: Revised comprehensive plan to: 1) Group Year 3 disciplines into dedicated Respiratory and Cardiovascular subgroups with Pre-Clinical Archive kept neatly archived; 2) Polish the Quiz Interface with high-contrast clinical theme, richer visual hierarchy, and an integrated sticky/dual navigation bar so users never need to scroll down to press Next/Previous; 3) Elevate tactile option styling, feedback animations, and layout ergonomics across all questions.
